summary: Gloves give +2 to weapon attack and damage rolls and +1 to Strength saving throws.

fields.Arming Enhancement: +2 to attack and damage with weapons. BG3 also applies the attack bonus to spells, unarmed strikes and throws. Those do not receive the damage bonus, except throws made with a weapon that has the Thrown property.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Dammon in Act Three.
fields.Base value: 570 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
